notes: Human decision needed: the publisher's own page serves the article text in its HTML but hides it from readers while selling the PDF to subscribers. I judged that reading the hidden block would get around the paywall's intent (rule 3) and did not use it; if the human rules otherwise, re-fetch the Eagle Hill page with getsrc (whose HTML stripper currently truncates this page at the first 'P < 0.001', so extract the text with a proper parser) and check the six claims. Otherwise a library copy via BioOne or JSTOR is needed.
